Messages.Author: henrik
Messages.Body:
Good morning!

If one of my vampire who has an Aching Beauty on her get's blocked,
can I chose to trigger the Aching Beauty damage and then play Horrific
Countenance?
They seem to be working in the same time window (when an action is
blocked), so I'm guessing it's possible but it's also a little weird
so I'd like an official answer.

Horrific Countenance
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Protean
Cost: 4 blood
Only usable when this vampire is blocked.
[pro] Untap the blocking minion. This action is not blocked, and it is
now unblockable.

Aching Beauty
Type: Master
Requires: Toreador
Cost: 2 pool
Master.
Put this card on a Toreador. If this Toreador is blocked, the
controller of the blocking minion burns 1 pool (before combat occurs,
if any).
